message: とろけそうなほど外国商

name: Lolotte
message: 「Preside~~nt!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Good timing♪ Do you happen to have any plans after this?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. I was thinking about heading home and studying or something」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No way! Haven't you been doing nothing but studying for the past few days?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, true」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So, you see. Why don't we go out for a little breather?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Just for a tiny bit, though♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah, I'm in, I'm in」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then it's decided--let's go!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, ah! H-Hey, wait up--!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You were practically floating in midair today」

name: Synn
message: 「Let me run on my own two feet properly...」
Where we arrived was the shopping district.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Shall we relax and have some tea?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Come to think of it, where's Amyrina?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I did invite her, but she turned me down, saying she had an expedition today」

name: Synn
message: 「Wahaha, she's just like you, Lolotte」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina and I are best friends, after all~~」
Well, even if she isn't used to it, Riesling-san is with her, so she'll surely be fine.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well then, let's head inside♪」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Welcome! Welcome to Chocolat l'Or! How many in your party?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Two people~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Well, well, if it isn't the Student Council President of Ryuusei Academy! Thank you so much for all your help back then」

name: Synn
message: 「Not at all. The pleasure was mine」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, you're the cake shop that had a booth at KiraFes, right」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Yes. We look forward to your continued patronage next time as well」

name: Synn
message: 「By all means」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「And if I recall correctly, the young lady with you is--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Allow me to formally introduce myself. I am the Student Council Secretary, Lolotte Rosenkreuz」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「My, how polite... I am--」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「R-Rosenkreuz!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes♪」

name: Synn
message: 「We're just planning to have tea as usual, is that alright?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Y-Yes!! Of course! Right this way, please\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Now then, the most modest option is--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What should we get~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Mgh!! Th-These prices are... quite steep」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The characters are too hard for me to read~~\s06」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Th-Thank you for waiting~~\s01」
What came out wasn't ice water, but a set of black tea and cake.

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? We haven't ordered yet, though?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「It is today's special recommendation」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh! How convenient, Mr. President. That saves us the trouble of deciding」

name: Synn
message: 「By the way, how much... does this cost?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「No, no! This is on the house」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... That's... W-we can't accept that. We came here as customers today, after all」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Please, do not hesitate. Rather, I am the one who owes an apology for my grave discourtesy in not realizing you were a daughter of the Rosenkreuz family...」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte. Did you do something?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When you say 'something,' what do you mean?」

name: Synn
message: 「Like eating every single cake in this shop before, for example」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even for me, about half is the absolute limit」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You just mentioned the name Rosenkreuz... Manager, are you an acquaintance of my Grandfather?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「N-no... My father has been deeply indebted to Lady Katerina for a very long time...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「My Grandmother, is it」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「I was told that we were only able to open Chocolat in Ryuusei Town thanks to Lady Katerina's generosity...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To bring such a wonderful shop here, Grandmother is wonderful too~~」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Yes, ma'am! I am most deeply honored!」

name: Synn
message: 「Heh~~. You're pretty amazing, Lolotte」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm really nothing special at all. It's simply that my Grandfather and Grandmother are remarkable」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Besides, aren't there other people from prestigious families at Ryuusei Academy as well?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Like Senpai, and Senpai's friends. The shrine maiden, and also... Sacchin-san, for instance」

name: Synn
message: 「Haaah... I really am surrounded by nothing but people like that, aren't I...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You have a rich heart, President, so isn't that wonderful?♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-you think so...」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「To think that my lady would grace us with her presence in person... It is the highest honor」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What are you talking about? I visit other shops quite frequently too, you know」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「W-what... If you would prefer, I would be happy to deliver directly to you...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There would be no meaning in that. If I do not explore on my own two feet, I cannot uncover the truth」

name: Synn
message: 「True. Eating at the shop definitely tastes better than getting delivery」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right♪ Just as expected of you, President. You really know your stuff」

name: Synn
message: 「Piping hot and freshly made is always the best」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「...Understood. Would you mind waiting just a moment?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, uh, yes」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So, do you think it's alright if we go ahead and have this?」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh... hmmm...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, the shop probably can't just take it back as is either, so... let's eat it!」

name: Synn
message: 「It'd be a waste otherwise」
And so, expressing our gratitude, we dig in.

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's so good~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks, Lolotte. Somehow I ended up getting treated too」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Not at all. All of this is thanks to Grandfather and Grandmother, after all」

name: Lolotte
message: 「They always let me do as I please... I hope I can repay Grandfather and Grandmother someday」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe you could get them a present or something」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A present, huh. Hmm-hmm... That's a great idea! I'll think of something~~」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Thank you for waiting」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, it's steaming...」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Our pastry chef had their hands full just now, so... I wouldn't go so far as to call it homemade, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be, you made it yourself, Manager...?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Yes! Even so, my skills are second to none compared to our other pastry chefs. It's freshly made, so please enjoy it while it's still hot」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Time to dig iiin!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Munch.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「O-Oooooh, oooooooooh!」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The piping-hot chocolate soaked deep into the sponge cake is exquisite~~」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「That's a flavor you can only get when it's freshly baked♪」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sorry... going out of your way to do all this for us.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Not at all. Seeing you enjoy it like that brings me the greatest joy.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Love really is the secret ingredient to deliciousness♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Man~~ That was delicious, and it made for a great breather.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, it really did! I feel like I can actually do my best studying for the tests after this!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha, is that all thanks to the cake?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's... part of it, too, but...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I think it's because I got to be with you, President.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To tell you the truth, um... I just... really wanted to see you, President...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「But without any Student Council activities, I didn't have an excuse to meet up...」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not true at all! Don't worry about stuff like that--you can come see me anytime you want.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Really!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, you're always coming up with some excuse to invite me out anyway, aren't you, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Was I really?」

name: Synn
message: 「Just like today, right? I have more fun and feel more energized when I'm with you too, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President...」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... well. Let's go out again sometime.」
Now~ then, time for one more push.
I feel someone's gaze on me.

name: Synn
message: 「Sasami?」

name: Sasami
message: 「Coo-coo」

name: Synn
message: 「You're a chicken, not a pigeon, you know」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Sneak, sneak...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Eek!」

name: Synn
message: 「Amyrina?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Hyaah! You've got the wrong person~~!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Sneak... sneak...」

name: Synn
message: 「If you get too close carelessly, Sasami's gonna attack you, you know?」

name: Sasami
message: 「Bawk」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Hieeeeee!」
Seriously, what is Amyrina even doing?
